Definition: from G998; to aid or relieve:--help, succor.
BiblicalUsage: To help is the word for aiding, succouring — and it appears eight times, mostly in cries for help. In Matthew 15:25 the woman of Canaan worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me. In Mark 9:22 the father of the possessed boy says, if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us, and in Mark 9:24 he cries, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief. And in Hebrews 2:18 Jesus is able to succour them that are tempted, because he himself suffered being tempted.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the father's cry is the prayer I pray most: Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief — and the Helper who was tempted himself answers it.
